name: Multi-field Visualization Combination
aliases: Combined Scalar and Vector Field Visualization
definition: A visualization strategy combining volumetric scalar fields (object volume) with vector field geometry (glyphs and streamlines from optical flow) to convey both object location and motion status.
summary: Multi-field Visualization Combination synthesizes volumetric scalar fields with vector field geometry to convey spatial structure and dynamic status simultaneously, distinguishing itself by layering distinct rendering techniques rather than mapping components into a single attribute space.
